about: Curated model registry for the portal's Models and Performance analyzer views. build_models.py reads the prediction files listed here, plus model runs it discovers under the discovery roots, and scores them. Paths are relative to the project root. Add a model by appending an entry to 'models'; a new run folder (reports/<run>/) or changed predictions become a new version automatically.

short.label: Short range
short.description: Daily discharge forecasts issued every day for the next 10, 15 or 30 days.
short.caveat: Most short-range experiments used realised ERA5-Land weather, with added noise, in place of archived weather forecasts. Scores are retrospective, not operational forecast accuracy. Consecutive daily issues overlap, so they are not independent samples.

long.label: Long range
long.description: Seasonal outlooks, the 180-day Temporal Fusion Transformer, the flood-peak model and climate projections.
long.caveat: The held-out test (issues from 2024) is short and dominated by the 2025 flood and possible upstream regulation changes. Climate-conditioned mode is given the observed future weather, so it is an upper bound. Projections are scenario statistics, not forecasts of a particular day.
